answer: The volume slider color has been successfully changed to a dark gray color (RGB: 50;50;50) in VLC media player. This darker color scheme will be much less straining on your eyes during nighttime or low-light environment usage. The change was made through Tools > Preferences > All settings > Interface > Main interfaces > Qt > Define the colors of the volume slider, where the original bright green value (15;245;39) was replaced with the dark gray value (50;50;50) and saved.
